purpose: Global nuclear and radiological infrastructure layer independent of the core TI country set.
principles: Do not limit nuclear coverage to the original 52 TI countries.
Separate global nuclear infrastructure from country-level traveller intelligence.
Use authoritative source data for discovery; preserve source provenance and status.
A facility record is not an incident. Live signals require corroboration before publication.
Country profiles are created for countries represented by the nuclear infrastructure inventory.

sources.name: IAEA Nuclear Fuel Cycle Information System
IAEA GNSSN Country Information
sources.role: country nuclear institutions and official links

buildTargets.countryProfiles: every country represented by one or more included nuclear facilities
buildTargets.locations: site-level locations wherever source data provides location information

notes: IAEA NFCIS states that coverage is global but records may be incomplete where countries have not reported data.
WNA Reactor Database is used as the practical current power-reactor inventory and is based on IAEA PRIS augmented by WNA.
Historical/decommissioned records are retained with lifecycle status where available because they remain relevant to nuclear/radiological intelligence.
The first live build should report source coverage and unresolved records rather than silently claiming completeness.
